purpose: Construct one clean graph and one single fault injected graph for each of the 180 locked SOSA and SSN confirmatory source units.

semantic_layers.clean_content_triples: record derived triples visible to extraction, repair, and clean reference comparison
semantic_layers.scaffold_triples: project profile targeting or RDF support triples excluded from clean reference comparison and grounding
semantic_layers.controlled_injection: one grouped fault transformation recorded as added and removed triples

usgs_adapter.representation: one daily Observation inside one record derived ObservationCollection
usgs_adapter.collection_interval: closed one day interval represented by collectionStart and collectionEnd
usgs_adapter.source_text_suffix: deterministically describes the record derived observation and collection wrapper

condition_constructors.disjointness: add SampleCollection type to an ObservationCollection
condition_constructors.functional_property_conflict: add a distinct second hasSimpleResult literal or a second explicitly different hasResult object
condition_constructors.domain_range: replace one valid relation endpoint with an entity of an incompatible explicitly represented profile class
condition_constructors.cardinality: remove one required observedProperty assertion and add a case level minCount constraint when the USGS profile does not already supply it
condition_constructors.temporal: replace one member phenomenon time with a value outside the collection interval
condition_constructors.grounding: replace one result value with a different structurally valid value absent from the source text

profile.layer: project SHACL application profile, not W3C SOSA and SSN axioms
